description: Bring the power of Statistical Process Control (SPC) into Power BI with an all-in-one visual designed to support continuous improvement and data-driven decision making. Key Features: Five Chart Types: Run Chart – quickly spot patterns and shifts in data. Individuals XmR Chart – Shewhart individuals control chart for monitoring process variation. p-Chart – track proportions or percentages over time. c-Chart – monitor the count of defects or events. u-Chart – evaluate defect rates per unit or opportunity. Intelligent Insights: Automatic detection of special cause concerns. Flexible baseline creation to track performance over different time periods. Dynamic limit recalculation as new data arrives. Customisation & Usability: Includes NHS Making Data Count icons for instant recognition and compliance. Personalise special cause rules, line colours, and styles to match organisational standards.
